Card Q&A.a: Yes, as long as it's a level 4 or lower Digimon, you can suspend it -- including your own Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's effect to suspend one my own Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: No, digivolving doesn't count as the card being played, so you can't suspend it.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's effect to suspend a level 4 Digimon when it Digivolves?

Card Q&A.a: No. Moving from the breeding area doesn't count as the card being played, so you can't suspend it.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's effect to suspend a level 4 or lower Digimon when it moves from the breeding area to the battle area?

Effect: [All Turns] When you or your opponent play a level 4 or lower Digimon, suspend it.
